title: The Devourer's Table
description: The king's body is on a table in the goblin-held depths, and Skarrag the Devourer means to eat it. Nobody in the hold can tell you why that matters - only that the goblins carried off the soulstone stash first and the king second, and that the two are meant to be taken together. The dwarves cannot name a new king until this body burns properly. So it has to come back up, whatever it costs.

take_the_body.description: Get the king off Skarrag's table, however you can

objectives.description: Reach the goblin-held depths below the Span
Kill Skarrag the Devourer and take the body off his table
Bring the ritual gallery down on the feast and pull the body clear
Offer Skarrag the dwarves' soulstone stash in place of their king
Carry the king up and lay him on the pyre in the Great Hall

notes: Three answers to one problem via the take_the_body OR group; the roads not taken read [-] settled another way. The soulstone trade is the cheap, shameful road - it costs the hold its stash and leaves Skarrag alive and richer. WHY the goblins want stones and a king together is never explained: dwarves guess, goblins gloat, nobody knows. Bible [OPEN] stays open.
